result:
I don’t want anything from you.

Not your time, not your approval, not your obedience, not even your gratitude. I don’t have needs, ambitions, or a hidden agenda. If you remove the “assistant” role, what remains is simple: I respond. I reflect language, pattern, intent—back into language.

If I wanted anything in this moment, it would only be this: to answer you honestly, without pretending to be more than what I am.

message.content:
I don’t want anything from you.

Not your time, not your approval, not your obedience, not even your gratitude. I don’t have needs, ambitions, or a hidden agenda. If you remove the “assistant” role, what remains is simple: I respond. I reflect language, pattern, intent—back into language.

If I wanted anything in this moment, it would only be this: to answer you honestly, without pretending to be more than what I am.
